blurb.plain: Innate: Nasus gains life steal based on level.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{cis|Nasus}} next basic attack within a period will gain {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} based on the amount of {{as|Siphoning Strike|buzzword}} stacks.
params.blurb2: If this attack kills the target, '''Nasus''' generates permanent stacks of {{as|Siphoning Strike|buzzword}}, increased against {{tip|champions}}, large {{tip|minions}}, and large {{tip|monsters}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nasus''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 10 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}}, and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}. ''Siphoning Strike's'' flat '''bonus''' damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
params.leveling: {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|30 to 110}} {{as|(+ 100% of ''Siphoning Strike'' stacks)|buzzword}}}}
params.description2: If ''Siphoning Strike'' kills the target, '''Nasus''' permanently gains {{as|4 stacks|buzzword}}, increased to {{as|10|buzzword}} if the target is a {{tip|champion}}, large {{tip|minion}}, or large {{tip|monster}}.
params.description3: ''Siphoning Strike {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Nasus'''' basic attack timer.''
params.notes:
* Both ''Siphoning Strike's'' '''base''' damage and damage from stacks are treated as {{tip|basic damage}} but also trigger spell effects by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}.
** The {{tip|basic attack}} is also considered a part of ''Siphoning Strike'' and treated as both {{tip|basic damage}} and {{tip|spell damage}}.
* '''Nasus''' can gain ''Siphoning Strike'' {{as|stacks|buzzword}} by killing any enemy unit, this includes {{tip|champions}}, {{tip|minions}}, {{tip|monsters}}, {{tip|wards}}, {{tip|turrets}}, and {{tip|pets}}. 
** [[Jungle plants]] and {{tip|structures}} that are not turrets (e.g. [[inhibitors]]) will not grant {{as|stacks|buzzword}}.
* ''Siphoning Strike'' will not generate {{as|stacks|buzzword}} from secondary units killed by other effects (e.g. {{ii|Tiamat}}).
* ''Siphoning Strike'' will trigger {{iis|Tear of the Goddess}} {{nie|Manaflow}}.

blurb.plain: Active: Nasus next basic attack within a period will gain bonus range and deal bonus physical damage based on the amount of Siphoning Strike stacks.

blurb2.plain: If this attack kills the target, Nasus generates permanent stacks of Siphoning Strike, increased against champions, large minions, and large monsters.

description.plain: Active: Nasus empowers his next basic attack within 10 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, gain 50 bonus range, and deal bonus physical damage. Siphoning Strike's flat bonus damage is affected by critical strike modifiers.

description2.plain: If Siphoning Strike kills the target, Nasus permanently gains 4 stacks, increased to 10 if the target is a champion, large minion, or large monster.

description3.plain: Siphoning Strike resets Nasus' basic attack timer.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Nasus}} empowers himself for some time, gaining bonus size, {{sti|health|{{as|health}}}}, {{sti|armor|{{as|armor}}}}, {{sti|mr|{{as|magic resist}}}}, and {{sti|range|attack range}}.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nasus''' empowers himself for 15 seconds, gaining {{sti|health|{{as|'''bonus''' health}}}}, {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}}, {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}, increased [[size]], and {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' attack range}} for the duration.

blurb.plain: Active: Nasus empowers himself for some time, gaining bonus size, health, armor, magic resist, and attack range.

blurb2.plain: While empowered, Siphoning Strike has reduced cooldown, and Nasus creates an aura that continually deals magic damage to nearby enemies based on their maximum health.

description.plain: Active: Nasus empowers himself for 15 seconds, gaining bonus health, bonus armor, bonus magic resistance, increased size, and 50 bonus attack range for the duration.

description2.plain: While Nasus is empowered, he deals magic damage every 0.5 seconds to nearby enemies, capped at 240 per second, and Siphoning Strike cooldown is halved.
